support_structural_sections.load_path: Each previously floating seed is now material-continuous through a stepped same-color beam into body-root walls/tubes/posts. Multiple spaced stud/cavity sites and bearing faces resist translation and rotation geometrically.
support_structural_sections.note: Positive material sections and CAD static balance are not an allowable bending/torsion strength or pullout test.

section_applicability.basis: Actual canonical type.body_slices, not a substituted comparison plane

sequence_method: Complete receiving-body-first dependency order with explicit multi-heightmodule support stages. All previously unsupportedtips travel with a continuousroot, not placed before theirconnection.
insertion_scope: All actual module/body cell columns and exact native root/support BRep samples at2.1/1/.3/0mm; unchanged monotone interface profiles. Hand access, print deformation, real friction and extraction are not validated.
